cascades_or_tumbles.how_it_works:
TUMBLE FEATURE
The TUMBLE FEATURE means that after every spin, winning combinations are paid and all winning symbols
 disappear. The remaining symbols fall to the bottom of the screen and the empty positions are replaced
 with symbols coming from above.
 Tumbling will continue until no more winning combinations appear as a result of a tumble. There's
 no limit to the number of possible tumbles.
All wins are added to the player's balance after all of the tumbles resulted from a base spin have been played.

wilds.name: WILD
wilds.behavior:
This is the WILD symbol. It can hit on all reels during spins
 and tumbles in both base game and FREE SPINS.
 Whenever a WILD symbol hits, it can carry a random multiplier value.
 Possible values are: 1x, 2x, 3x, 4x, 5x, 6x, 7x, 8x, 9x, 10x, 15x, 20x, 25x, 30x, 50x or 100x.
 During spins and tumbles, any multiplier that hits is collected in a meter on top of the reel the WILD that was
 carrying it hit. Every win from clusters is multiplied by the sum of all multipliers on top of the reels that had
 winning symbols on them, part of the cluster. At the end of all tumbles resulted from a spin, the multipliers
 are cleared from the top of the reels.

wilds.name: WILD
wilds.behavior:
FREE SPINS
 Hit 3, 4, 5 or 6 or more SCATTER symbols to trigger the FREE SPINS feature and win 10, 12, 15 or 20 free
 spins respectively. If the round is triggered by 6 or more SCATTER symbols, it uses the SUPER FREE
 SPINS rule, that the minimum multiplier that can hit on a WILD symbol during this round is 10x.
 During the FREE SPINS round, all multipliers that get collected on top of each reel, do not get cleared at
 the end of tumbles and stay on the screen until the end of the round.
 During the FREE SPINS round, the possible multiplier values are as follows: 1x, 2x, 3x, 4x, 5x,
 6x, 7x, 8x, 9x, 10x, 15x, 20x, 25x, 30x, 50x, 100x, 200x or 500x.
 Hit 3, 4, 5 or 6 or more SCATTER symbols during the round to retrigger the feature and win 5,
 7, 10 or 12 additional free spins respectively.
 Special reels are in play during the feature.

features.name: Buy Free Spins
features.effects:
The FREE SPINS round can be instantly triggered from the base game by buying it.
 Pay 100x total bet to trigger the FREE SPINS feature with 3, 4, 5 or 6 SCATTER symbols
 are guaranteed to hit randomly on the triggering spin.
 Pay 500x total bet to trigger the SUPER FREE SPINS feature. In the SUPER FREE SPINS
 feature, the minimum multiplier that can hit on a WILD symbol is 10x. When buying
 the SUPER FREE SPINS feature 3, 4, 5 or 6 SCATTER symbols are guaranteed to hit
 randomly on the triggering spin.
